documents_expected.why: third call guidelines: eligibility, co-funding, forms, due diligence, deadlines

eligibility.rule: Legal entity registered in an EU Outermost Region or Overseas Country or Territory
eligibility.quote: A private or public legal entity registered in ORs and/or OCTs (*). International organisations (inclusive of regional organisations with international membership), individual consultants and sole traders are not eligible to receive a grant (**).

eligibility.rule: Runs the project itself, not as an intermediary
eligibility.quote: Directly responsible for the preparation and implementation of the grant project. Applications submitted by a body acting as an intermediary for a third party are not eligible.

eligibility.rule: Bank account in the organisation's name where it is based or works
eligibility.quote: Have a bank account in the name of the organisation and in the place where the Grantee is established or where the project is carried out

eligibility.rule: Organisations in EU Member States only as co-applicants, with local authority support
eligibility.quote: Organisations that are registered in the EU Member States can only apply as coapplicants, provided the project has the support of OR/OCT authorities (e.g. letter of support)

eligibility.rule: Regional and territorial governments only with a local NGO, CBO, SME, municipality or research institute
eligibility.quote: if they co-apply with at least one of the following organisations: local NGOs, local CSOs, local CBOs, SMEs, municipalities or local research institutes

eligibility.rule: At most two proposals per call per organisation
eligibility.quote: An organisation can submit and be awarded a maximum of two proposals per call

eligibility.rule: 18 to 36 months, starting July to September 2027
eligibility.quote: Project duration must range between 18 to 36 months (including any potential extensions)
alt_quotes: Projects must have a start date between July to September 2027.

documents.item: IUCN eligibility self-declaration and authorised representative
documents.quote: The organisation's self-declaration and the details of its authorised representative.

documents.item: Signed co-applicant mandate and sworn statement for each co-applicant
documents.quote: signed co-applicant mandates and sworn statements where relevant.
alt_quotes: Co-applicants must sign the Co-applicant Mandate available on the BESTLIFE2030 website.

documents.item: Concept note with financing plan, budget summary and environmental and social screening
documents.quote: The project concept, financing plan, completed budget summary and preliminary environmental and social screening.

documents.item: Full proposal (if invited): narrative, logical framework, maps, personnel and safeguards
documents.quote: The developed narrative, completed logical framework Excel file, maps, personnel information and safeguard documents where required.

documents.item: Detailed budget Excel template with supporting estimates
documents.quote: The completed detailed budget Excel template, matching financing totals and documents supporting the estimates.
Founding instrument: statutes, constitution, incorporation document or decree for a public body; registration and authorisation to operate where applicable.

documents.item: Latest audit and two years of financial statements
documents.quote: Latest audit report and management letter where an audit is performed; annual financial statements for the past two years where prepared.

documents.item: Accounting, procurement, ethics and anti-corruption policies
documents.quote: Existing accounting and procurement policies, code of conduct/ethics and anticorruption provisions, including conflict-of-interest coverage, as requested.

documents.item: Operating budget for this year and the two before
documents.quote: Provide operating budget figures for this year and the two previous years in the reporting currency requested.

effort.step: Complete the IUCN and BESTLIFE2030 eligibility forms in the Grants Management Facility
effort.quote: Sign in to the IUCN Grants Management Facility (GMF) (https://gms-portal.iucn.org/) and open the BESTLIFE2030 third call.

effort.step: Send questions on the concept note
effort.quote: Deadline for requesting any clarifications regarding concept notes 3 December 2026* 14:00 CET
Concept notes must be submitted by 8 December 2026 at 14:00 CET.

effort.step: If shortlisted, write the full proposal and detailed budget (around April 2027)
effort.quote: The full proposal deadline will be communicated in the invitation to shortlisted applicants.
Complete the Due Diligence form when it is made available and requested in the application process.

co_finance_required.quote: A minimum of 5% co-funding of the total budget is required

consortium_required.quote: The lead applicant may act individually or with co-applicant(s).

notes: Two stages: concept note, then full proposal by invitation. Grants up to EUR 100,000 per project; indirect costs capped at 7%, and running costs can't count as own resources. English or French. Reporting duties aren't stated in the guidelines; the grant contract isn't published. Special access rules for uninhabited and low-population territories.
